name: NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX)
description: A multi-dimensional rating scale assessing perceived workload across six subscales: Mental Demand, Physical Demand, Temporal Demand, Performance, Effort, and Frustration.
reputation: Most widely used workload assessment; free public domain; used in aviation, medicine, HCI, and military.
notes: Subjective measure; weighting procedure sometimes omitted; single time-point assessment.
